notes.title: NEW GAME MODE: MINIGAMES ONLY
notes.notes:
Hello,

As requested by some players, Alien League has now a new game mode where there is no board, just minigame after minigame in which players battle for the most wins!

[h1][b]--------| UPDATE v1.2 |--------[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW game mode: MINIGAMES ONLY[/b]

[*] Added the option to change the length of the game in both game modes
[*] Fixed a crash where the game would completely stop
[/list]

notes.title: Alien League on Steam!
notes.notes:
THE DAY HAS FINALLY COME!

Alien League has been released! So make sure you grab your copy and call all your friends for a game session today!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34530226/e84866d8eac43cb0deb45470ecc8a34b71badfcc.png[/img]

notes.title: Alien League will be released on March 1st!
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow competitive party gamers! Fasten your seat belts and get ready to join the greatest competition of the universe, Alien League!

On March 1st, gather your friends and family, buy some snacks and prepare for the major alien event out there! Who will be the next Champion?

Alien League is already public at the store but can only be wishlisted for now, make sure to grab your copy on release!
